title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Opens at #1 in Japan, Grotesqqque Anime Film at #8
content: Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla sequel film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , ranked at #1 in its first weekend. The film sold 699,000 tickets and earned 1,130,171,300 yen (about US$7.11 million) over the November 6-8 weekend.
author: ANN

content: Crunchyroll announced on Wednesday that it will stream the premieres of the anime adaptation of Sumiko Arai 's The Guy She Was Interested In Wasn't a Guy at All ( Ki ni Natteru Hito ga Otoko Janakatta ) manga, the anime adaptation of D JUN 's Here U Are webtoon, the television anime of Yukino Sonoyama 's Bless manga,…

title: 3 Gutsiest Characters In One Piece
content: The pirate’s life is paved with blood and near-death experiences, especially when it comes to the characters in One Piece . It takes some unhinged individuals to face super powered Warlords, Marine Admirals and ruthless pirates, yet Monkey D. Luffy and friends almost embrace the agony .
author: ComicBook

title: Gundam Seed Freedom Zero Prequel Anime Film Gets Novel
content: Goto penned the novelizations for Mobile Suit Gundam Seed and Mobile Suit Gundam Seed Destiny and also penned the script for the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed FREEDOM film. Tomofumi Ogasawara , who drew illustrations for the Mobile Suit Gundam Seed novelization, is drawing the illustrations for the novels.
author: ANN

title: Forgotten 2000s Classic Gets New U.S. Release With No Hopes for Season 2
content: One of the most beloved Shonen hits from the 2000s returned with a Blu-ray release this year, while there has been no hope for Season 2. With the massive expansion of the anime industry over the past few years, catering to a global audience.
author: ComicBook

title: Final Fantasy XIV Game Band The Primals' Bassist Eikichi Iwai Dies
content: Iwai had just performed a concert with the band during the game's Fan Festival event in Tokyo on November 1. The Primals, led by the composer and sound director of Final Fantasy XIV Masayoshi Soken, have performed official cover music from Final Fantasy XIV since 2014.
author: ANN

title: Classic Shonen Sparks Reboot Rumors After 24 Years
content: A forgotten anime classic of the 2000s is again in the spotlight after a cryptic post, sparking reboot rumors. Reboot anime series have taken over the industry in recent years, especially with the release of The Ghost in the Shell and Magic Knight Rayearth .
author: ComicBook

title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 7 Preview Continues Fight Against Megicula
content: Black Clover Season 2 has released preview images and synopsis for Episode 7 (Episode 177 overall) ahead of its November 14 premiere. The new season officially began on October 3, 2026 , with Crunchyroll streaming it worldwide. The anime previously revealed a special Valkyrie Dress Noelle following Episode 6.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dragon Ball Super Remake Star Confirms English Dub Will Be Newer Than You Think
content: Dragon Ball Super is about to kick off the official English dub release for its new remake anime series, and one of the stars behind it all has confirmed that Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is going to be much newer than fans might expect.
author: ComicBook

title: Dark Crunchyroll Fantasy Confirms Season 2 Spring Return After 4 Years With New Look
content: A dark fantasy anime that you can now find streaming with Crunchyroll has now set a Spring release for its return next year, and its second season has dropped a new look at its comeback after four long years.
author: ComicBook
